SliderSelectionView in Figma

The `m3e-slider` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.slider [] [ M3e.sliderThumb [] [] ]
M3e.Slider.el { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [] [] } [] []
M3e.Slider.build { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [] [] }
|> M3e.Slider.toElement
<m3e-slider>
<m3e-slider-thumb></m3e-slider-thumb>
</m3e-slider>

Selecting a value

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.slider
[ M3e.Slider.min 1
, M3e.Slider.max 5
, M3e.Slider.step 0.5
]
[ M3e.sliderThumb [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 1.5 ] [] ]
M3e.Slider.el { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 1.5 ] [] }
[ M3e.Slider.min 1
, M3e.Slider.max 5
, M3e.Slider.step 0.5
]
[]
M3e.Slider.build { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 1.5 ] [] }
|> M3e.Slider.withMin 1
|> M3e.Slider.withMax 5
|> M3e.Slider.withStep 0.5
|> M3e.Slider.toElement
<m3e-slider min="1" max="5" step="0.5">
<m3e-slider-thumb value="1.5"></m3e-slider-thumb>
</m3e-slider>

Selecting a range

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.slider []
[ M3e.sliderThumb [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 20 ] []
, M3e.sliderThumb [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 80 ] []
]
M3e.Slider.el { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 20 ] [] } [] [ M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 80 ] [] ]
M3e.Slider.build { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 20 ] [] }
|> M3e.Slider.withChild (M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value 80 ] [])
|> M3e.Slider.toElement
<m3e-slider>
<m3e-slider-thumb value="20"></m3e-slider-thumb>
<m3e-slider-thumb value="80"></m3e-slider-thumb>
</m3e-slider>

M3e.Slider.build { content = M3e.SliderThumb.view [ M3e.SliderThumb.value -20 ] [] }

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-slider produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Size

The size values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Constructor
slider : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Internal.Types.Slider.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element childAccepts (M3e.Internal.Types.Slider.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Internal.Types.Slider.Is s) admittedBy msg

The loose m3e-slider producer — open attribute/child rows, no required record. See M3e.Component.Slider.component for the required-content form.
